title: ÆTHER album Kaattu Thee, song 3: Fight (instrumental, 1 min test)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: A modern Tamil film fight-scene theme, instrumental, new-generation Kollywood action style. Built around ONE strong, menacing, catchy riff in a dark minor key with an Indian flavour, first on a low distorted bass guitar, then on a fierce reedy nadaswaram-like synth lead with heavy brass stabs. The riff is short, repeats often and is easy to hum. Clean, hard-hitting, musical production with space, not noisy: thunderous parai and thavil drums locked with a modern hybrid trap and industrial beat, deep 808 sub bass, sharp metallic hits on the punches, a gang war-cry shout only on the biggest hits. 140 BPM. Starts quiet and tense with a ticking pulse, a low drone and the riff alone, a slow-motion moment with a single heartbeat drum and silence, then a massive drop around 18 seconds where drums, bass and brass slam the full riff. A second, faster and bigger statement of the riff with a rising string ostinato, ends on one brutal hit and silence.

brief.notes: Jithesh 13:16: locked intro instrumental take 1 (expand to a longer BGM later); 'Now let's try a fight one'. Same approach that worked: instrumental, one clear melodic hook carrying it, clean punchy production with space, a real build and one big drop.

story: Rudra, cornered in a rain-soaked Chennai warehouse by twenty men, stops running and fights back.
